hometestimonials.description1: I liked the service of krashuved very much. They are transparent in everything, and also make payments on time. He talks to everyone clearly and respectfully.
hometestimonials.description2: Krashuved bought potatoes from me and gave good rates compared to other traders and markets. I didn't need to go anywhere. They came to the cold store, checked the quality, and offered me a rate. They were on time to load potatoes and make payment.
hometestimonials.description3: I was not able to sell my LR potatoes to anyone. Rest of the people were giving very low rates. Then I contacted Krashuved. He not only bought potatoes but also gave fair rates.
